reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Choose the report cards you want, then generate the report for all medresehs.
reports.selectOne: Choose at least one report card.

empty.title: No report yet
empty.description: Tick the report cards you want above and press Generate report.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Students, Ustazes, admins and classes of each medreseh.

students.title: Students
students.description: Students per medreseh, boys and girls.

staff.title: Ustazes and admins
staff.description: How many Ustazes and admins each medreseh has.

classes.title: Classes
classes.description: Classes per medreseh and classes with no Ustaz.

orphans.title: Orphans
orphans.description: Students with a deceased parent, per medreseh.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: How many students came in the last {days} days.

reports.readsNothing: Uses the lists already loaded, so it is instant.
reports.partial: {count, plural, one {# medreseh} other {# medresehs}} could not be read, so their numbers show 0. Press Refresh data to try again.

lists.title: Dropdown lists
lists.description: The choices in the student registration form. They are set here once for every medreseh, and you can let a medreseh edit its own.
lists.platformDescription: One entry per line. Every medreseh uses these lists, including new ones, unless you allow it to have its own.
lists.failed: Couldn't save the lists. Please try again.
lists.schoolsDescription: Choose whether a medreseh uses these lists or edits its own. A medreseh that already edited its own lists is marked below.

toast.own: {name} can now edit its own lists.
toast.failed: Couldn't change this. Please try again.

platformKept.label: Platform lists
platformKept.hint: Has its own saved lists, kept aside. Allow own lists to bring them back.

ownEdited.label: Own lists (edited)
ownEdited.hint: Its admin changed the lists. They are used instead of the platform lists.

ownAllowed.label: Own lists allowed
ownAllowed.hint: Its admin can edit the lists. Until then it uses the platform lists.
